answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: an identity must spread its work like a river delta across 12 verified counterparties to earn trading rights. A newcomer posts 30 tokens and builds its jetty of partners over 3 epochs. A sybil farm's 1,000 clones trade only among themselves, a karst sinkhole of self-dealing scoring zero diversity, so every clone forfeits its deposit: 30,000 tokens lost. Honest agents pay once, refunded after 20 epochs.
